entries.reachability: Every hero move into an occupied square. C reaches domove_attackmon_at() at 2798 and test_move() only at 2843, and the port now matches: js/hack.js:1691 calls do_attack() and :1711 calls test_move(). u.ux0 and u.uy0 are written above both, as at hack.c:2780-2781.
entries.effects: Ordering alone, and it is observable on exactly one live path: a pet displacement off an intact doorway. C spends do_attack()'s rn2(7) at uhitm.c:474 and then either lets test_move()'s exit rule (hack.c:1208-1214) decline the step for no time, or takes uhitm.c:497-502, which flees the pet for rnd(6) and consumes the turn without reaching test_move() at all. The 33 development sessions move no screen and no call, which is expected: none of them stands on a doorway beside its pet.
entries.evidence: scripts/run-pet-doorway-displacement.mjs records 10 fresh C cases over both outcomes, both roles, both dates and all four diagonals, plus a doorless negative half, and passes: 25980 PRNG calls, 40 screens, 40 cursors. With the two calls swapped back it fails at PRNG call 2215 with C drawing rn2(7)=1 from do_attack(uhitm.c:474) where the port draws rn2(2)=0. scripts/pet-doorway-displacement.test.mjs replays the same recipes without the recorder.
entries.remaining: None for the ordering. sourceReview: Every C span named here was confirmed by printing its first and last line rather than citing it. All 13 uhitm.c spans and both mon.c spans in the goal's detail were correct; the js/hack.js line numbers in the same block had drifted 6 to 15 lines and were corrected in 1e594f2. The random-number order was traced to the point where each witness stops: seed0200 draws rnd(20) at 780, rnd(4) at 847 and rnd(100) at 1576; seed0006 draws rnd(20) at 780 then rnd(6) at weapon.c:265; seed0107 draws rnd(20) at 780 for the miss, rnd(20) at 804 for the hit, then rnd(6) at weapon.c:265. Two ordering traps are recorded and unresolved: maybe_knockback is computed at uhitm.c:1829-1831 and discarded at 1923 whenever the monster dies, so eager evaluation of mhitm_knockback() desyncs on every kill; and silver damage is added at two independent sites, rnd(20) inside dmgval at weapon.c:332 for weapons and rnd(20) inside special_dmgval at weapon.c:403, 412 and 422 for bare hands added at uhitm.c:861, so a port consolidating them double-counts. Two state-ownership questions are settled: struct _hitmon_data at include/you.h:511-552 is per-call scratch allocated on C's stack at 1760 and becomes a plain JavaScript object created in hmon_hitmon() and threaded by reference, with all 27 fields initialized explicitly in definition order matching 1763-1793; gt.twohits is genuine turn-scoped state with one owner in js/uhitm.js written only by hitum(), and hmon_hitmon() must copy it into hmd.twohits at 1765 with the ranged zeroing rather than reading the global downstream. Stubs and stops identified: requireOrdinaryStartingPetSwap() at js/hack.js:1048-1052 refuses every hostile destination, and js/uhitm.js:52 refuses it again below domove(); js/unported_monster_actions.js:782-784 refuses monster retaliation and constrains validation of the miss and hit entries; js/makemon_create.js:2282 is a merged mon_leaving_level plus m_detach plus mongone port that discards inventory and must be reconciled before the kill path drops a monster's gear.
